Adventure freshest-track popup: native source reconstruction

Configured Linux executable:
  /home/lulika/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Dwarf Fortress/dwarfort
  ELF build ID bcc6789e6fb477b785a2b02be80b8b1b054ff88c
  Main Adventure renderer: 0x1c25b40..0x1c41ab0
  Requested popup construction: 0x1c3d362..0x1c3e3df

elf-decompiled.c is actual Ghidra 12.1.2 C output for the complete renderer
and its three complete noun producers. DecompileTracking.java is the script
used for this offline extraction. It defines native call boundaries and the
eight direction-switch targets, and raises the decompiler response buffer to
256 MiB for the large renderer. elf-renderer.asm and the three supplier ASM
files retain every instruction and optimized literal operand. Decompiler
inference can leave overlapping literals as UNK pointers; elf-literals.tsv
retains their exact bytes, including all four diagonal location strings.

All addresses here are ELF virtual addresses. No running process, desktop,
translation self-test or simulated display was used for this extraction.

Source fields
  Active spoor block: global 0x297b0d8.
  Active tile coordinates: globals 0x297b0cc / 0x297b0d0.
  Tile index: (x % 16) * 16 + (y % 16).
  block + 0x8   + index*2: uint16 flags.
  block + 0x208 + index:   uint8 type.
  block + 0x308 + index*4: id1.
  block + 0x708 + index*4: id2.
  block + 0xb08 + index*4: id3.
  Types: 0 vegetation, 1 historical-figure/caste/body-part, 2 item, 3 mess.
  Other type values, including NONE=255, add no description sentence.
  Flags: 0x2 has direction; 0x1c direction selector; 0x20 player/companion;
         0x40 liquid print; 0x180 intensity.

These operands agree with the existing df.block.xml spoor_type/spoor_flag
definitions; the executable operands supply the actual layout and branches.

Popup ownership and visibility
  Texture selection and mouse bounds gate this popup. A zero selected texture
  or absent active block skips it. This supplies no alternative text.
  A nonempty cached popup with rebuild bit 0x100 clear reuses existing text.
  A rebuild clears the native curses_text_boxst at 0x2701cb8 and adds:
    "Freshest track"
    blank paragraph
    optional relative-location paragraph
    blank paragraph after that location
    description paragraph, if the type selects one
    optional track-direction sentence
    optional ownership sentence

Each complete paragraph is submitted through 0x423910, the ELF PLT entry for
curses_text_boxst::add_paragraph(std::string const&, int), with width 24.
This is why a complete sentence can occupy several visible rows. Existing
append_map_hover_phrases joins connected sentence rows before catalog lookup.
Its frame, margin and blank-row boundaries keep headings and labels separate.

Relative location: nine complete strings
  Position helper 0xb13dc0 selects the adventurer coordinate. Sentinel -30000
  (0x8ad0) skips the entire location paragraph, including its blank separator.
  Otherwise native coordinate comparisons choose west/east/north/south,
  northwest/northeast/southwest/southeast, or "At your location".
  All alternatives append the literal ":" at 0x1c3d4a5 before submission.
  Axis-dominant directions require one absolute coordinate difference to be
  greater than twice the other. Equality follows the diagonal/same-position
  branch. An empty constructed bearing falls back to "At your location".
  Runtime catalog entries contain the complete label with its colon.

Description: vegetation and mess
  type=0:
    flags&0x180 == 0x180: "The vegetation is heavily damaged."
    flags&0x180 == 0x100: "The vegetation is bent."
    flags&0x180 == 0x80:  "The vegetation has been slightly perturbed."
    flags&0x180 == 0:     "The vegetation is broken."
  type=3:
    "There is an unintelligible mess."

The existing report sentences use "here" and "This is". They are distinct
source strings and remain in the catalog beside these actual popup strings.

Description: item
  type=2 uses id1=item type, id2=subtype, id3=orientation.
  Prefix is always "There is a ".
  Non-liquid intensity: 0x180 "deep ", 0x100 "shallow ", 0x80 "vague ",
                        0 no adjective.
  Liquid intensity:     0x180 "thick ", 0x100 "light ", 0x80 "faint ",
                        0 no adjective.
  Liquid branch adds complete liquid material + " " before the item.
  If id3&1 is set, add "right ". Otherwise if id3&2 is set, add "left ".
  If neither is set, add no orientation word. Right takes priority when both
  bits are set.
  Noun supplier 0x12b6a70 receives the item type/subtype, singular count=1,
  no item material and no live-item ID. Its native size and RAW item-name
  branches remain in the complete supplier extraction.
  Non-liquid suffix: " imprint in the " + complete surface material + "."
  Liquid suffix: " print."

Description: species/body part
  type=1 uses id2 to select the combined caste index and id3's low signed word
  as the body-part index. Species/caste is supplied by 0x12ae800, singular,
  with the selected caste. RAW singular names, caste fallback and invalid or
  empty names are retained in the complete producer C and ASM.
  Body-part vector is caste+0x6c0; name vector is part+0x90; first element
  supplies the singular body-part name.
  Non-liquid with an available part-name vector:
    "There is a " + species + "'s " + intensity + part +
    " imprint in the " + surface + "."
  Non-liquid with a negative/out-of-range part or empty name vector:
    "There is a " + species + " imprint in the " + surface + "."
    This branch omits both the possessive and intensity adjective.
  Liquid:
    "There is a " + species + "'s " + intensity + liquid +
    (available part-name vector ? " " + part : "") + " print."

Thus both owned families require their zero-intensity template. A RAW vector
can also exist with an empty first name string: explicit whole-sentence
templates retain this omission without permitting empty generic captures.
When a body part is unavailable, the surviving species-only imprint uses
the scoped creature/caste grammar. A liquid-only tail uses the complete
material grammar already supported by translate_map_track_noun.

Material producers
  Liquid lookup 0x6e9bc0 supplies type/index/state metadata. Type=-1 is
  replaced with type=6 and state metadata=1 before formatting.
  Surface lookup 0x6e9b20 falls back to 0x6dbe50 if type=-1.
  Both use 0x74ca90 for the complete material name; the caller selects liquid
  or solid state. Material names can include creature, plant, tissue and
  phase qualifiers. They use the existing complete material grammar.

Direction and ownership suffixes are independent
  If flags&2 is set, flags&0x1c indexes the table at 0x21dcdfc:
    0 north, 4 south, 8 east, 12 northeast,
    16 west, 20 northwest, 24 southeast, 28 southwest.
  Each adds the complete sentence "The signs lead <direction>."
  If flags&0x20 is set, add "They belong to you or a companion."
  Each missing flag skips only its own sentence. The suffix decisions follow
  all description branches, including the default with no description.

Runtime handling
  data/runtime/ui-messages.tsv contains all complete finite popup strings,
  the sixteen named intensity/ownership templates, and explicit empty-name
  sentences. Existing report variants remain available.
  src/dfcn.cpp binds species owners to map_hover::track_owner, the printed
  noun to translate_map_track_noun, and the final imprint surface directly
  to translate_material_name. Empty-name templates keep those field roles.
  src/map_hover.inc resolves the actual species-only fallback through the
  scoped singular creature/caste vocabulary. Existing anatomy, equipment,
  liquid material and left/right parsers supply dynamic names.

native-productions.tsv retains each source family, branch condition,
literal/formatted production, native address and runtime handler, including
all no-new-text branches. It is source provenance, not a display result.
